priorityList: Mind Freeze to interrupt spellcasting whenever possible.
Cast Pillar of Frost on cooldown, ensuring it syncs with Breath of Sindragosa or Reaper's Mark if they are available.
Cast Reaper's Mark when Pillar of Frost is ready or about to become ready.
Cast Breath of Sindragosa if Pillar of Frost is active or combat is nearly over.
Cast Frostwyrm's Fury at the end of a Pillar of Frost window or when Unholy Strength is about to expire to maximize damage.
Cast Remorseless Winter if Gathering Storm is talented or if multiple enemies are present.
Use Empower Rune Weapon if you are low on Runes/Runic Power or during Pillar of Frost to sustain resources.
Cast Obliterate if you have 2 stacks of Killing Machine or if you have 1 stack and at least 3 Runes.
Cast Howling Blast whenever Rime is active.
Cast Frost Strike if the target has 5 stacks of Razorice and you have the Shattering Blade talent.
Cast Frost Strike if you are near maximum Runic Power to avoid capping.
Cast Obliterate whenever Killing Machine is active.
Cast Frost Strike as your primary Runic Power spender to maintain resource flow.
Cast Obliterate to spend Runes when not in an Obliteration window.
Use offensive trinkets and racial abilities specifically during your Pillar of Frost window.
